description: Repository class for managing coin data, including fetching from an API and local database, handling price updates via WebSocket, and exposing the data as flows.

classes.name: CoinRepository
classes.description: Handles the interactions with coin data, including fetching from API and local database, and managing real-time price updates.

methods.name: refreshCoins
methods.description: Fetches the latest coin data from the API and updates the local database.

methods.name: startPriceUpdates
methods.description: Initiates WebSocket connection for real-time price updates of coins.

methods.name: reconnectWebSocket
methods.description: Reconnects to the WebSocket after disconnection.

methods.name: updateCoinPrice
methods.description: Updates the price of a specific coin in the local database.

methods.name: getCoinChart
methods.description: Fetches the chart data for a specific coin based on ID and number of days.

methods.name: getPrices
methods.description: Fetches the current prices of multiple coins based on their IDs.
